about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Protegey is Africa's first shared early-warning network for fraud intelligence. We are building the digital infrastructure to secure the continent's financial future, starting with Francophone and Northern Africa.
about.mission_text: To eliminate fraud as a barrier to digital commerce in Africa by creating a unified, real-time intelligence network.
about.vision_text: A trusted digital ecosystem where businesses can grow without fear of financial loss from fraud.
about.why_exist_text: Fraud in Africa is not just a nuisance; it's an existential threat to the digital economy. Siloed data means fraudsters can attack one institution and move to the next without detection. Protegey changes that.
about.why_exist_text2: By aggregating signals from fintechs, banks, telcos, and merchants, we create a 'herd immunity' effect. When one member detects a threat, everyone is protected.
